title: Crate Labels

reward.description: Brass letter stencils in a velvet roll. The Q is missing; nobody knows why.

hints: In an f-string, {x:.<12} pads x with dots on the right to 12 characters, and {w:>8.2f} right-aligns a number in 8 characters with 2 decimals.
name[:12] cuts a string down to at most 12 characters. Do that before padding.
{amount:,.2f} adds thousands commas: f"{1234.5:,.2f}" is "1,234.50". Handle negatives by formatting abs(amount) and adding the minus sign yourself.
